answer_1.quote: We conduct thorough experiments, examining key aspects of the context compressor, such as pretraining tasks, model and data size, compression rate, and efficiency in various downstream tasks.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs include answers to questions in RAG-based QA, solutions to mathematical reasoning problems, sentiment predictions, resolution of Winograd schemas, and role-playing responses.

answer_2.quote: We use commonly-used metrics in machine translation, namely BLEU and ROUGE.
